title: Works Fine, But The Design Is More Hype Than Function
text: Works Fine, But The Design Is More Hype Than Function. Overall this works, but plastic isn't as good as glass, the two separate parts need to be cleaned separately, and the shape is awkward to hold.  Next time I'll buy a traditional Pyrex measuring glass instead.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Multi-Unit Measuring Cup, 4-Cup,Gray
features: Ideal measuring jug for liquid or Dry ingredients, including both metric and imperial Measurement markings, and spout for precise pouring
Makes it easy to measure an array of common ingredients, quickly with one vessel, with markings for: milk, oil, sugar, brown sugar, rice, oats, beans, water and flour
Rotating plastic sleeve allows users to limit view to one Measurement at a time
Silhouette and capacity perfect for immersion blending or hand mixing
Handle to aid when pouring, and to help the user secure the vessel while mixing
Dishwasher safe/ inner and outer body come apart for easy cleaning
description: For good measure an innovative spin on traditional measurement jugs our multi-unit measurement jug is an innovative spin on traditional measurement jugs. Rotate the removable plastic sleeve to view one measurement at a time, making measuring multiple ingredients quick and easy. Perfect for liquid or dry ingredients the jug has metric and Imperial measurement markings and markings for kitchen staples including milk, oil, sugar, Brown sugar, rice, oats, beans, water, and flour. The generous size accommodates immersion blenders and hand mixers. With a drip-free spout and balanced handle for precise pouring, the dishwasher-safe jug and rotating sleeve come apart for easy cleaning.
